description: CUR-SEEK, variant: omitted, Null and Empty key components in leading, middle and trailing position on IX_ABC. Each new table-type recordset starts at the last index row; Seek = and >= with the keys (Missing,2), (Missing,2,1), (1,Missing,1), (1,2,Missing), (Null,2), (Empty,2,1), (1,Null,1) and (1,2,Null); after each Errors, NoMatch, BOF, EOF and ID are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
